description: This file defines the IndentedCodeRenderer class, which extends CodeRenderer to render indented code blocks, specifically for the Markdown format in a Confluence content context.

classes.name: IndentedCodeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for indented code blocks in Markdown, used within Confluence content formatting.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an IndentedCode node into an HTML element by calling getHTMLElement with the node's literal content.
